title: Event Clusterer — Output Cluster Record
description: One cluster per line in clusters.jsonl. Each cluster groups articles about the same event by entity-pair overlap (primary) or single-entity overlap (fallback). Acceptance criteria from the live monolith: cluster must contain ≥3 articles from ≥2 distinct sources. The cluster carries member_hashes (for downstream re-joining with the full article cache) and source_ids (for bloc-coverage computation downstream).

cluster_id.description: Stable identifier derived from sorted member-hashes; same articles → same cluster_id across runs.

label.description: Human-readable cluster label. For entity-pair clusters: 'EntityA+EntityB'. For single-entity clusters: 'Entity'. Used by downstream framing comparison.

label_type.description: How the cluster was formed: 'pair' = entity-pair overlap (primary path); 'single' = single-entity fallback for unpaired articles.

member_hashes.description: Article hashes that belong to this cluster. Must match keys in the input news_cache.jsonl. Length is also reported in member_count for fast filtering.

member_count.description: len(member_hashes). Convenience field; downstream filters use this without materializing member_hashes.

source_ids.description: Distinct source identifiers represented in this cluster. Used by coverage/blindspot downstream.
